items.title: 53342_Cozy Cole oral history interview
items.q: I did quite a few of those Jackie Gleason recording dates.

ctx.x: Piano, Yeah, but he was mostly in the control room, controlling everything. So I approached them all, I said to them, do you want to make this record. It was in the morning. And said all we got to do is one number, there's no three numbers for no record date, one number. I told them that too, I said all we're doing is one number. Now maybe I was spoiled a little bit, because I'd been used to doing those one-numbered sessions with Jackie Gleason and just one number and that's all, no three and four numbers during…
